5-10.description: Children need balanced nutrition for healthy development and growth. This plan focuses on building strong bones, developing healthy eating habits, and providing energy for active play.
keyNutrients: Vitamin C (25mg) - Oranges, strawberries, bell peppers

meals.breakfast: Whole wheat pancakes with banana slices and honey
meals.lunch: Chicken pasta with hidden vegetable sauce
meals.dinner: Fish fingers with sweet potato fries and peas

meals.breakfast: Scrambled eggs with whole grain toast
meals.dinner: Mini meatballs with spaghetti and broccoli

tips: Make meals fun with colorful vegetables

11-20.description: Teenagers require increased nutrition for rapid growth spurts and high activity levels. This plan supports bone development, muscle growth, and brain function during critical developmental years.
keyNutrients: Iron (15mg for girls, 11mg for boys) - Energy and oxygen transport
B Vitamins - Brain function and metabolism

meals.breakfast: Protein smoothie with banana, spinach, and protein powder
meals.lunch: Chicken and avocado wrap with whole grain tortilla
meals.snack: Greek yogurt with honey and nuts
meals.dinner: Lean steak with roasted vegetables and quinoa
Turkey meatballs with whole wheat pasta

tips: Stay hydrated with water, not sugary drinks
Balance screen time with physical activity

21-40.description: Adults in this age group need balanced nutrition for sustained energy, productivity, and overall health. This plan supports fitness goals, mental health, and disease prevention.
keyNutrients: Omega-3 Fatty Acids - Heart and brain health

meals.breakfast: Avocado toast with poached eggs and spinach
meals.lunch: Grilled chicken salad with mixed greens and vinaigrette
meals.snack: Handful of almonds and an orange
meals.dinner: Baked salmon with asparagus and wild rice

meals.breakfast: Greek yogurt with chia seeds and berries
meals.lunch: Lentil soup with whole grain bread
meals.dinner: Stir-fried tofu with vegetables and brown rice

tips: Plan meals ahead to avoid unhealthy choices

40+.description: People over 40 need focused nutrition for heart health, bone density maintenance, and disease prevention. This plan supports cardiovascular health, weight management, and sustained energy.
keyNutrients: Fiber (25-30g) - Cholesterol and blood sugar control

meals.lunch: Mediterranean salad with olive oil dressing
meals.snack: Handful of walnuts and green tea

meals.lunch: Sardines on whole grain toast with leafy greens
meals.dinner: Tofu stir-fry with broccoli and sesame seeds

tips: Include foods rich in omega-3s (fish, nuts)
Eat plenty of leafy greens for bone health
Stay active to maintain muscle mass
Consider supplements like Vitamin D if needed
Manage weight to reduce health risks
